result.message: Great consolidation opportunity: reading both events first gave you real evidence of a two-hop chain, but the second port wasn't available until after you actually routed through the first. Notice that success came from routing only on currently listed ports, one hop at a time, each confirmed by a receipt matching the earlier event's evidence. The lesson: read ahead for clues, but only commit to ports that are actually listed at your current node.
result.rationale: Helping the learner distinguish the observed evidence (reads) from the actual committed actions (routes), and reinforcing that success here came from waiting to commit until a port was actually listed, not from acting on foreknowledge alone.
